title: Atherial Shaders
description: A simple, vibrant shader for iris
body:
# Aetherial Shaders (Beta)

Aetherial Shaders is a vibrant Minecraft shader pack focused on delivering beautiful lighting, crystal-clear water, rich colors, and a cinematic atmosphere while preserving Minecraft's iconic art style.

This is an early beta release, meaning it's still under active development. While many core features are already functional, expect bugs, missing effects, and unfinished dimensions as development continues.

## ✨ Features
🌅 Warm, cinematic sunrises and sunsets

💧 Clear, vibrant water with reflections

🌊 Improved underwater lighting and visibility

🌳 Enhanced lighting for forests and landscapes

☀️ Soft bloom and atmospheric lighting

🌌 Improved night sky

🎨 Vibrant color grading

⚡ Optimized for Iris Shaders

🔧 Designed as a foundation for many future visual improvements

## ⚠️ Beta Notice

This shader is not feature complete.

Known issues include:


❌ The Nether does not render correctly.

❌ The End currently has major rendering issues.

❌ Some blocks may fail to render or appear black.

❌ Lighting inconsistencies may occur in certain situations.

❌ Visual artifacts and glitches are expected.

❌ Performance has not yet been fully optimized.

Please remember that this is an experimental build intended for testing and feedback.

## 📅 Planned Features

Development is ongoing, with plans to add:

1. Better shadows
1. Improved ambient lighting
1. Volumetric clouds
1. Improved reflections
1. Better bloom
1. Dynamic weather effects
1. Enhanced fog
1. Improved water rendering
1. Better dimension support
1. More customization options
1. Performance improvements
1. Additional graphical polish
## 💻 Requirements
Minecraft Java Edition

Iris Shaders

Sodium (recommended)

## 🐞 Bug Reports

If you encounter visual glitches, rendering problems, or performance issues, please report them with:

- Minecraft version
- Iris version
- Graphics card
- Screenshot (if possible)
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- 
Feedback helps improve future versions.

## ❤️ Thank You

Thank you for trying the first public beta of Aetherial Shaders. Every update will bring new features, bug fixes, and visual improvements as the shader evolves into a more polished experience.

Current Status: 🧪 Beta — Expect bugs, experiment, and enjoy watching the project grow.
